title: Configuration tableau output index
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean work-tape symbols, let $n,T\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $z$ be a finite Boolean string. The output vertex of the configuration-tableau circuit for $M$, with $n$ circuit inputs, hard-wired string $z$, and time bound $T$, is the value of the linear expression for the current snapshot’s encoded output bit, evaluated on the register values at time $T+1$ with loop counter zero.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-state Turing machine over Boolean symbols
